current_direction: One visible Tactical Power pool with Available, Powered, and Spent states.

next_action: Update runtime only after baseline calibration.

current_direction: Available may become Powered, earmarked, or Spent; actual Powered/Spent power never returns during the turn.
checkpoint_25_decision: Shutting down ends the effect but leaves the power locked and normally prohibits same-turn restart.
next_action: Validate decision burden at four boundaries.

current_direction: Before Movement, Direct Fire, Missiles, and Damage Control.
checkpoint_25_decision: Treat as optional activation deadlines, not mandatory full reallocation prompts.
next_action: Testing may consolidate windows.

reference_influence: Need meaningful delayed activation without retroactivity.
checkpoint_25_decision: Finalize all boundary changes, then refresh once.

current_direction: Mid-turn reactor damage changes the next refresh, not current distributed power.
checkpoint_25_decision: Snapshot current-turn power from post-Damage-Control condition.
next_action: Add explicit catastrophic exceptions only when named.

current_direction: PDS includes local tracking and fire control.
checkpoint_25_decision: Readiness is Powered; family differences use power, ammunition, and performance.
next_action: Tune kinetic, AMM, and energy PDS.

current_direction: Shield Hardener supplies SA that resists shield-facing damage after SPEN bypass.
reference_influence: User correction to the older Shield Protection label.
checkpoint_25_decision: Use Shield Armor (SA) in the Concept and baseline.
next_action: Update all active documentation.

current_direction: Active shield overload creates temporary overcapacity; collapsed shield overload improves next legal recovery.
checkpoint_25_decision: No same-turn restart in the baseline.
next_action: Test advanced immediate restart separately only if needed.

current_direction: Kinetic uses ammunition and little/no TP; energy uses more TP and no ammo; missiles use finite ammo and no launch TP.
checkpoint_25_decision: Hybrid weapons combine explicit tradeoffs.
next_action: Test situational viability, not exact parity.

current_direction: Earmark Available power and reserve the weapon cycle; spend only if triggered.
checkpoint_25_decision: Unused earmark releases after the declared window.
next_action: Keep earmark out of the three-state player display.

current_direction: Final charge payment occurs at turn start; Ready weapons fire without more power and may pay Spent upkeep indefinitely when allowed.
checkpoint_25_decision: FTL clears all charge and Ready state; normal retention adds no Strain.
next_action: Component-specific maximum and hazards.

current_direction: Safe overload auto-succeeds; only overload beyond the resulting Strain Limit rolls.
checkpoint_25_decision: Success works, failure does not, criticals add effects; Strain persists.
next_action: Use exact provisional TL1 success value for testing.

current_direction: Damage Control may remove Strain; full drydock/station service removes all.
checkpoint_25_decision: FTL does not remove Strain.
next_action: Tune DC chance and quantity.

current_direction: Main and Auxiliary Reactors supply core and Tactical Power together; APU supplies core only.
checkpoint_25_decision: Auxiliary Reactor remains wired and independent unless explicitly damaged.
next_action: Test main-reactor loss and feedback only as explicit critical effects.

current_direction: Combat Battery one discharge/turn; Capacitor one charge or discharge operation/turn.
checkpoint_25_decision: Battery is finite; capacitor is reusable storage.
next_action: Test capacitor charging windows.

current_direction: Ordinary STL/FTL use drive and fuel; EvM costs extra fuel and 1 TP; STL overload adds Move and tractor resistance.
checkpoint_25_decision: No default EvM overload; Emergency FTL Jump remains separate.
next_action: Tune degraded double penalties and emergency jump later.

current_direction: Beam attack; Tractor Power subtracts from effective STL Move. Equal holds; excess pulls toward source.
checkpoint_25_decision: Multiple tractors add but can only hold, not reposition or pull.
next_action: Define conflict geometry only when needed.

current_direction: Rare Powered system, no default overload, cannot recloak in the same turn after shutdown.
checkpoint_25_decision: Restrictions and decloak penalties remain component-specific.
next_action: Likely Precursor or rare technology.

current_direction: Only Turn Refresh and FTL transition are universal resets.
checkpoint_25_decision: FTL clears tactical state but does not repair or replenish.
next_action: Implement explicit reset profiles.

current_direction: Separate pristine, persistent current, derived, and turn-local values; use optional profile blocks.
checkpoint_25_decision: Prune unused fields during implementation.
